# Humankind In Monolith, Humans were one of the first organisms in the Orion arm to achieve practical spaceflight. AS they progressed, they eventually became masters of their very genetics. In a time long before Corporate war set humanity up for true galactic dominance, many eccentric humans collaborated on various genemodding projects, whether for function or for form. These progenitors, though few in number, managed to pass on their unusual genetics to their children, and from their children to their children's children, and so on. This mix of genotypes has not gone over well with everyone, though, and conflicts were waged over the very genetics of humanity, resulting in commonplace regulations on genemodding. While controversial, these regulations (such as the Tellion 7 Alliance Biomodification Statute of 2773) have largely succeeded in preventing further genemodifications, leaving only the large quantities of existing genemodded humans that have successfully spread across society.
Many of these different genemods have existed for centuries at this point, have established their own cultures and have faced adversity. Despite this, they are almost as common as regular humans and are generally treated as such.
